method: Four sequential fresh native oss-rnd child subjects, fork_turns=none, one round each. budget_scope: Count frozen administrator wrapper + observed NEW_TASK prefix + actual tool-return text as input. Packet source bytes are informational and not counted twice. original_contract_preserved: Frozen v1 bytes and all 13 original case values remain unchanged in v1. Supplemental v2 contains only the four newly executed cases with unchanged field format, administration, criteria and budgets.
